'''Weapons masters''' were beings highly skilled in the art of fighting with weapons of all kind. One such being was [[Giles Durane]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], weapons masters of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] were among the deadliest beings of the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance's ground forces]]. They often wore heavy armor.
